item_findings.S-1: Historical readings, reserve, failed backup, queue count, storage arithmetic and deferred Gate 0 reproduce. Rates are observations, not bounds. DRAFT:83 misattributes the separate 2026/10/03 rollout to the 2026/10/04 directory aggregate; file-growth attribution and snapshot timing need qualification.
item_findings.F-1: Sealed UNQUALIFIED verdict and blocker direction match. DRAFT:159 asserts impossibility beyond frame-v6-PLAN:67-68; excerpts at 141-147 omit material portions of the full required changes. DRAFT:172 overstates the observed linger precedent.
item_findings.W-1: Candidate protection from sicarii is plausible, but custody, setup, failure, resource and rollback claims are not yet sufficient or exact. Proposal:154,156 creates the primary and clients groups; proposal:264 says one. Optional image payload formulas reproduce, not usable filesystem or safe-capacity minima.
item_findings.P-1: AST reconstruction observes 169 effective keys; all independent normalized digests match source, and E1 per-packet replacement payload membership matches. Scope is files/ replacement payloads, not every packet artifact. C-PINS is quoted faithfully and its lead-brief provenance is correct; routine implementation deltas require no approval solely because pinned.
item_findings.R-1: Raw warn_error tuples and evidence pins match; 25 unique notices comprise 19 spec notices on 11 declarations, 2 Prefix_Tail notices and 4 body witnesses. The package's 10 functions is false. Packet 13 remains an untested hypothesis.
item_findings.R-2: Chain and packet-14 numeral instances reproduce exactly, as conditional source call counts. D1383 is Result_Conforms and D1384 Compute, not self-recursive Prefix_Total Posts. C-SLOT's independent slot-size/bounded-value qualification and C-SUM/C-OWNER/C-P12-REACH consequences are insufficiently carried.
item_findings.C-1: D-13 exact v3 ruling and conditional component-local ABI/scope-preserving option match; v2/v3 closure ceilings remain design-only.
item_findings.C-2: N-06 exact v3 ruling matches: reprovisioning is operator-custody deployment work; the old library is only a hold, not acceptance.
item_findings.C-3: N-01 exact v3 ruling and mandatory O for material C-ABI changes match; representation-warning repair remains strict routine work after legal movement and individual review.
item_findings.N-1: D1 v2/v3 verdicts and R-OD1 quote match. Option consequences need expansion from the sealed review/design: preserving mitigation, model/migration, runtime identity and original-helper obligations cannot be reduced to option names.
item_findings.N-2: R-OD2 quote, 640 chunk guard, 192 direct-name census plus omitted alias match. Minimum sites are 193, not exhaustive. 'Unlimited across 11 classes' overstates E1: original examiner/payload/control exclusions and native/build_guard disposition remain V3-RC1 requirements.
item_findings.N-3: R-NOTICE/R-WORKSPACE and native-layout/exhaustion ceilings match. The D2 package must explicitly carry all requested correction consequences, rather than merely refer to binding rulings.
item_findings.RW-1: Sealed design-only endorsement, static lane defects, conditional mutex deadlock and reserved actions match. The pre-dispatch check count is observed as three; no executed race/deadlock or acceptance is established.
item_findings.isolation: Disclosed guard refusals, withdrawn alternate-tool fallback clearance, linked worktree history and noncompliant earlier pre-read are carried. Historical successes provide no clearance; this review reads no gbrain files and creates no new operational authority.
